Enum BlendLogicOperation

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Defines logic operations for pixel blending using bitwise boolean calculations.

public enum BlendLogicOperation

Fields

And = 6

Performs a bitwise AND between source and destination.

AndInverted = 13

Performs NOT Source AND Destination.

AndReverse = 12

Performs Source AND NOT Destination.

Clear = 0

Sets the result to zero (0).

Copy = 2

Copies the source value to the destination.

CopyInverted = 3

Inverts and copies the source value.

Equiv = 11

Performs a bitwise equivalence (XNOR) between source and destination.

Invert = 5

Inverts the destination value.

Nand = 7

Performs a bitwise NAND between source and destination.

NoOp = 4

Keeps the destination value unchanged (No Operation).

Nor = 9

Performs a bitwise NOR between source and destination.

Or = 8

Performs a bitwise OR between source and destination.

OrInverted = 15

Performs NOT Source OR Destination.

OrReverse = 14

Performs Source OR NOT Destination.

Set = 1

Sets the result to all ones (1 or 0xFF).

Xor = 10

Performs a bitwise XOR between source and destination.
